title: Bound Proof Pack rebuilds to trusted roots
summary: Restrict Tdarr Proof Pack rebuilds to the canonical operator root or an internal disposable test parent, validate root-bound sentinel identity, and recover from failed rebuilds.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W11-012. The public CLI accepts arbitrary proof roots and a same-named sentinel alone currently authorizes recursive deletion of the selected directory.
behavior_before: --rebuild accepts any absolute or repository-relative proof root and calls shutil.rmtree when a child with the sentinel filename exists, without validating sentinel content, root identity, or path containment.
behavior_after: Public materialization accepts only the canonical resolved Proof Pack root. Internal tests may inject a strict child of an explicit disposable parent. Symlink, junction, and reparse components are rejected. Rebuild requires a parsed sentinel with the expected schema, purpose, exact root path/hash, and nonzero build nonce; the old tree is renamed to a sibling quarantine and restored if population fails.
tests_added: Arbitrary public roots fail before mutation and preserve unrelated files.
Malformed, schema-only, wrong-purpose, and copied sentinels fail root-identity validation and preserve their directories.
A Windows directory junction escaping the disposable parent is rejected without touching its target.
A successful rebuild retains the prior proof tree in a sibling quarantine.
A post-quarantine population failure restores the prior root and preserves failed partial output.
manual_validation: Focused Proof Pack tests passed: 5 tests, including the Windows junction fallback with no skips.
Adjacent Tdarr Proof Pack, matrix audit, and desktop service slice passed: 53 tests and 8 subtests.
Targeted Ruff validation passed for the changed Python implementation and tests.
Targeted summary freshness, project index/dependency graph, feature map, risky-file registry, git diff --check, and strict worktree coverage passed; strict coverage reported 1,164 valid packets.
rollback_plan: Revert the proof-root boundary, sentinel identity, quarantine/rollback flow, disposable-root tests, generated summaries/maps, and this packet together. Preserve any reported quarantine or failed-partial directories for manual recovery.
notes: High-risk disposable-filesystem validation only. No source media or operator proof library will be touched; representative real media is not required because the behavior is exercised with synthetic temporary proof fixtures.
